svg.text: HA: liveness probe · readiness probe · rolling update · auto-restart · rollback
Secrets (DB/Redis pwd) · ConfigMap · PVC connector plugins
Ingress → Gateway pods (round-robin) · Gateway → Integration pods (K8s ClusterIP) · All pods share Redis + MSSQL pool → stateless, scale freely
Connector plugins: Generic HTTP (config-driven JSON) + Custom DLL (Bank E SDK) — loaded at runtime by ConnectorFactory, wrapped in Polly resilience pipeline
